items.title: This Husband and Wife Design Duo Wants You to Put Color Back Into Your Home
items.content_text: In big ways and small, the interior designers Giancarlo Valle and Jane Keltner de Valle look for ways to inject rich palettes into living spaces. Here’s how they do it.

items.title: A next-generation weight-loss drug from Eli Lilly, when combined with Zepbound, helped people lose substantially more weight than Zepbound alone, according to a new study
items.content_text: A drug combination studied in people with Type 2 diabetes lowered blood sugar and helped people lose more weight than with Zepbound alone.

items.title: Architects Never Loved the Kennedy Center. But They Don’t Want to See It Gone.
items.content_text: President Trump threatened to demolish the Kennedy Center, designed by Edward Durell Stone, after efforts to put his name on the Modernist building faced legal challenges.

items.title: Skintight Running Unitards Are Having a Masculine Moment
items.content_text: Amateur male runners are ditching shorts for skintight speedsuits, but not because they make them faster.

items.title: A Bucket-List Trip to the Seychelles Is Now Easier Than Ever
items.content_text: American tourists have long overlooked the smallest country in Africa, with no direct flights from the U.S. As travelers chase farther-flung getaways, the Seychelles has recently drawn an influx of luxury retreats.

items.title: Novo Inks Weight-Loss Licensing Deal With Hengrui Pharma
items.content_text: The Danish drugmaker signed a licensing deal for a weight-loss treatment being developed by Hengrui Pharma that could be worth up to $2.6 billion.

items.title: Beep, beep, beep. There has to be a better way than those incessant sounds in hospitals.
items.content_text: The alarms keep patients from getting sleep and overwhelm nurses. Now, researchers are making alarms smarter and less annoying.

items.title: Why Artist Taryn Simon Eats Cereal with Diet Coke Instead of Milk
items.content_text: The multidisciplinary artist’s new show at the Guggenheim traces an FBI agent’s career through photography, video and sculpture.

items.title: Prada Is Wooing the Ultrarich With Snorkeling Trips and $100,000 Skirts
items.content_text: The fashion house is working to close the gap with rivals in courting top spenders as it navigates a difficult climate for luxury retail.
